scope: CPU-only strict binary64 arithmetic lowering prerequisite; no float64 source admission, typed ABI, tasks, tensors, conversions or GPU arithmetic enabled.

implementation.shared_engine: Binary32/binary64 format specialization shares alignment, sticky shifts, logarithmic normalization, packing and special-case selection. Binary32 retains i64 intermediates; binary64 uses i128. No native floating arithmetic remains in the proof LLVM IR.
implementation.rounding: nearest, ties-to-even after each elementary arithmetic operation; gradual underflow, signed zeros and infinities
implementation.nan: Internal arithmetic canonical NaN 0x7ff8000000000000; negation flips exactly the sign bit, preserving payload and signaling bits. No public NaN payload guarantee is introduced.
implementation.guards: CPU API rejects GPU/SPIR-V operations and unsupported arithmetic formats/vectors/operations; existing binary32/Metal API still rejects binary64. Failed proof-tool invocations preserve the destination file.
implementation.performance: Not measured; integer lowering is a correctness implementation, not a hardware-double speed claim.

qualification.reference: LLVM APFloat IEEEdouble, nearest-ties-to-even; exact bits including canonical arithmetic NaN and payload-preserving negation
qualification.floating_environments: Four ARM rounding modes with FZ/DN disabled and enabled (8 modes); verifies installed controls, unchanged floating exception flags, separate rounding/reassociation case, restores FPCR/FPSR.
qualification.corpus: Signed IEEE edge cross-product, every encoded exponent in both operand positions against selected exponent boundaries, every subnormal leading bit, cancellation neighbors, full-range deterministic random bit patterns, underflow/overflow/quotient-rounding neighbors and halfway/FMA-sensitive cases.
qualification.mixed_formats: Proof module includes unchanged binary32 operations beside binary64 functions; artifact inspection verifies both result widths and i128 arithmetic.
qualification.build_configuration: Optional Metal proof configuration; new binary64 runtime tests themselves are CPU-only, on macOS ARM64.

next: Qualify float64 source literals/inference, ordinary functions, typed native entries and structured worker captures/results. Tensor/GPU binary64 arithmetic remains separate.
distributed_execution: No changes; discuss the native design before implementation.
